guide_solution: Mainul Islam is a qualified farmer in Naogaon. He lives in his village with his two brothers. When he was asked, "What makes you decide to stay here in this village?" question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: Mainul Islam is a qualified farmer in Naogaon He lives in his village with his two brothers When he was asked What makes you decide to stay here in this village He replied Look its true that we could leave this village for a city life But it didnt attract us Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: Mainul Islam is a qualified teacher in Naogaon. He lives in his village with his two brothers. When he was asked “What makes you decide to stay here in this village?” He replied, “Look, it’s true that we could leave this village for a city life. But it didn’t attract us.”
